object: Wall label to figure E in the sculptured Meroitic Chamber
site: Philae, Great Temple of Isis, Meroitic Chamber
notes: Published L., D., VI, Bl. 3, no. 8; photo Berlin Academy 719, 720. Griffith translates ll. 1-2 'The khabkheñ, qer of Isis, the honourable Mashtaraqaye' (see 111) and says qo in l. 2 should probably have begun the inscription, l. 1 being perhaps an afterthought; l. 3 woSi : yntke 'Isis, my mistress(?)'; ll. 3-5 seem to be an invocation to Isis and Patrêt (ptroti). His '?' stands over the l of pli. The type has k (flat Z top) in pikl and pikn where FHN III no. 267 reads pipl, pipn, and ẖ at the end of pḫilẖ (the 2026-11-09 test misread it as m).
